messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Contact and Conversation" as it appears in the following examples.
['I am expecting to hear from you as soon as possible.', 'Once you confirm your availability, I would provide you with more helping details.', 'Please confirm that it is the same auction with the one posted on eBay link: http://signin.ebay.com/viewitem/390079883827', 'Therefore, if my proposal satisfies you, kindly contact me via email address and enclose your phone and fax numbers for urgent confidential discussion.', 'Please your urgent response will be highly appreciated.', 'Please if you are ready to assist us, Kindly forward the following so that we can forward it to the bank for open of account with them for you so that they can transfer the fund through telegraphic wire transfer to your nominated account in your country.', 'Do not hesitate to call me on my phone for further directives or send me email to enable us commence towards the conclusion of this transaction.', 'If you are interested please kindly furnish me without personal phone and fax numbers for excommunication.', 'you are to fill the following below and send only to our computer analyst (Kate Berry) email on kateberry3@aol.com for immediate validation.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
